properties.name: A read reminds the agent of loop debt at the moment of attention
properties.statement: The agent should be reminded of outstanding coherence-loop debt while it is looking at the graph mid-session — not only at SessionStart (fires once) and Stop (fires at the very end). Reads (scan_nodes, get_node, search_design, graph_report, …) are the agent's first and most frequent action, so a read that returns while the loop is owed something is a well-timed place to surface it, closing the gap between the two existing triggers. This is the read-side sibling of the write tools' loop_hint and a member of the BL-74 "fire on a trigger, not on virtue" family: the reminder must ride a call the agent already makes, so remembering reflow2 does not depend on the agent's discipline under operational load.
